inheritanceBasis: Each new saved vertex is within1micrometre of an explicit convex combination of its original same-tooth vertex and original tooth centroid. Both centroid and vertex are in the original same-tooth convex hull. Topology, UV, root/tip local coordinates and sampled dental parent matrices retained. Original fixed-Head rigid jaw analytic scope only.
sameArchScope: 120 pairs per arch, actual finite vertices/surfaces, invariant under the common rigid arch parent. Not a true global minimum or signed distance.
stillUnaccepted: Full continuous tooth/gum/tongue/skin volumes and contacts.
Other head/body actions, natural hair/cloth, independent soft cages and engine.
Whole-character realism and user female approval.
